currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful elevated west/north/south pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM; no bespoke surveys or photo redistribution.

pictures.observations: Elevated southwest view: three pointed west portals with steep gabled hoods, central rose/large pointed panel, two roofless upper west tower shells, narrow minaret on northern corner, lower long aisles, taller clerestory and flying arches to stepped outer piers. A pale low vaulted roof remains over the worship hall. Broad front terrace and south-edge steps are visible; full interiors/ornament not reconstructed.

Elevated northwest front: northern minaret, two open upper tower windows beneath pointed gables, central lower rose panel/gable, three pointed door bays and incomplete parapet/pinnacle profiles. Warm limestone exterior. Exact stone tracery, sculptural figures, lettering and damage outlines omitted.
